scores.justification: The main weakness is that the Firestore database schema (Table 3) describes the eight collections only in high-level prose rather than specifying exact document field names, data types, and foreign-key reference fields in the text. Otherwise, Sections 2.0 to 8.0 thoroughly cover stakeholder problems and mapped use-case solutions, 17 functional requirements, role-based CRUD permissions, MVVM architecture with a repository layer, and clear design trade-offs.
requires verifiable evidence: marked in a live session

A minor weakness is that the Appendix B test case tables omit explicit test input steps/values and rely on a summary 'Pass' column rather than recording distinct expected versus actual outputs. Otherwise, Section 9.0 and Appendix B are exceptionally thorough, documenting a five-level automated testing strategy (unit, widget, Android integration, Firebase emulator security rules, and live Firebase E2E) across 106 test cases with 88.4% line coverage and 16 logged defects and fixes (Table 8).
